expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Sigiriya, Ella and Mirissa in one week is the route I recommend to every first timer under forty. Heritage, hills and the sea in that order.
expert.tip: Climb Sigiriya before breakfast. The gates open at seven, the steps are in shade and you are back down before the heat and the crowds arrive.

summary: Six days with a small group: Kandy and the elephants, the tea country, the hill train to Ella, and two nights on the beach with the Madu River, water sports and the turtle centre. All transfers, breakfasts and dinners included.
included: Included: 5 nights in deluxe and super deluxe hotels with breakfast and dinner daily; shared arrival and departure airport transfers and all road travel by air conditioned coach; Pinnawala and Kandy sightseeing; the hill country transfer with highlights; the Nuwara Eliya to Ella train journey; Ella sightseeing; the Madu River boat ride; the water sports combo at Bentota; the Kosgoda turtle conservation centre.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches; entrance tickets where payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses. Single travellers are matched in twin rooms or can pay a single supplement.
